- Thu 2026-03-26 15:00–15:45

Draft agenda:

Hi Elaine and team,

Great — thanks for confirming. We're on for Wed 03/25 09:00 PT (invite sent). To make the kickoff productive, I've sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and attached the PO template and SOC2 attestation. High level:

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- Day 0 (Kickoff): confirm primary contacts, review vendor_request form, agree PO terms
- Day 1–3: Acme returns completed onboarding form + W-9 (if US entity)
- Day 4–7: Redwood returns final SOW/contract or minor redline agreement; Redwood provides SOC2 attestation and data-residency note
- Day 8–14: Acme issues PO; Redwood confirms billing account and start date
- Go-live: dependent on integration scope — target within 2–4 weeks after PO receipt

Success criteria (what success looks like)
- PO issued and accepted by Redwood finance
- Billing contact and invoicing schedule validated
- Required evidence received (onboarding form, W-9, SOC2) and stored in Acme vendor record
- A named product/ops contact at Acme with an agreed start date for integration/testing

Attached: redwood_po_template_v2.xlsx, redwood_soc2_attestation_2025.pdf.

If Acme requires Net30, Redwood can support Net30 once credit terms are set in our finance system — if your team can confirm Net30 in the kickoff we'll route to finance immediately so we can accept a PO with those terms.

Looking forward to the discussion on Wednesday.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
